Try a 20‑minute garlic‑ginger chicken stir‑fry: sauté sliced chicken breast with minced garlic and ginger, add broccoli florets, bell pepper strips, and snap peas, splash soy sauce and a touch of honey, cook until veggies are crisp‑tender, serve over cooked rice or noodles.

PLAN: Gather ingredients: chicken breast, garlic, ginger, broccoli, bell pepper, snap peas, soy sauce, honey, rice or noodles.
PLAN: Prep – mince garlic and ginger, slice chicken, cut veggies into bite‑size pieces.
PLAN: Cook chicken in hot pan 3‑4 min until browned, then set aside.
PLAN: Add veggies, stir‑fry 2‑3 min, return chicken, splash soy sauce and honey, toss 1 min.
PLAN: Serve over rice or noodles, enjoy!
